facts.value: Under the Student Service, students of the Department of Economics find various support and advisory services for different study-related questions.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: The E! Week with its mentoring program is the ideal start to studies for all bachelor students, introducing first-year students to Goethe University, the department, campus life, and the city of Frankfurt in a three-day program.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Our master's students are warmly welcomed on the Master Welcome Day and receive important information.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: The event series 'Bachelor meets Business' aims to create a forum for exchange between science and practice, inviting a selection of companies each winter semester. Master's students are also welcome.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: The Dean's List aims to honor outstanding academic achievements and bring students and companies into contact with each other. This special honor from the dean is awarded every semester to the best bachelor and master students.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: All bachelor and master graduates receive an invitation to the graduation ceremony, where the study completion is traditionally celebrated with caps.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Please also note the dates of important information events as well as our Student News.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy
